---
title: "R code to generate Individual patient trajectory plot"
output: html_document
params:
    continuous_data: NA
    no_doseD: NA
    func_D: NA
    final_tD: NA
    idD: NA
    continuous_date: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    axissize: 30
    x_lab: "Timepoint" 
    y_lab: "Score in PRO domain" 
    arrow_lab: "Better \n tolerability" 
    range: c(0,100) 
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run the code
# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer"))

library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Set the parameters
continuous_data <- params$continuous_data
no_doseD <- params$no_doseD
func_D <- params$func_D
final_tD <- params$final_tD
idD <- params$idD
continuous_date <- params$continuous_date

# Logic to deal with timepoints as a date
if (continuous_date == TRUE) {
    continuous_data$timepoint == as.Date(continuous_data$timepoint)
}

# Filter the data to include only the relevant dose, patient IDs, timepoints, and PRO domain
continuous_data <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseD) %>%
    filter(id %in% idD) %>%
    filter(timepoint <= final_tD) %>%
    filter(functioning == func_D) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-functioning)
continuous_data <- data.frame(continuous_data)

# Create labels for each patient to include their ID and dose level
labels_D <- paste0("ID ", continuous_data$id, " (Dose: ", continuous_data$dose, ")")

# Convert the dose column to a factor for plotting
continuous_data$dose <- as.factor(continuous_data$dose)

# Set up graphical parameters
lims <- params$range
minval <- min(continuous_data$score, na.rm = TRUE)
maxval <- max(continuous_data$score, na.rm = TRUE)
lower <- min(c(minval, lims[1]))
upper <- max(c(maxval, lims[2]))

# Generate the individual patient trajectory plot
ggplot(data = continuous_data, aes(
    x = as.factor(timepoint),
    y = score, group = id, colour = labels_D, linetype = dose
)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.9) +
    labs(linetype = "Dose") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    ylim(c(lower, upper)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
        y = params$y_lab,
        x = params$x_lab,
        color = "Patient (Dose)"
    ) +
    ggtitle(params$title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = params$axissize)) +
    geom_segment(
        x = 0.2, xend = 0.2, y = lower, yend = upper,
        colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(
            type = "closed",
            length = unit(0.1, "inches")
        ), inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(x = -0.2, y = upper * 0.9, label = params$arrow_lab, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(2, 0)))
```
